name: @office/events
description: Office event ledger and transactional outbox (OFF-005): the append-only event ledger with ledger-assigned per-aggregate sequences and deterministic event ids, the transactional outbox enqueued in the same transaction as state writes, and the idempotent consumer cursor with causation/correlation propagation. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, and @office/persistence.
